name: timer-native
description: From the Damocles title screen, press Space once, wait for world load, capture, then disassemble the live 68000 code from $04C400 through $04D3FF. This window covers $0004C6B2, the fourth native routine named Unresolved in docs/research/damocles-script-isa.md and asked for by #136, reported reached from the timer path near $051D62. The window is placed below $04C6B2 so it also covers $0004C556 — the routine address $054848 installs into the vector slot $0004BF54 — and the shared tails at $0004C5EC and $0004C5C6 that this code branches to, keeping the one-level callee chase inside a single pinned listing. It needs a scenario of its own because Hatari allows one listing of at most 0x1000 bytes per run, and this region lies far below the $0547xx cluster covered by scenarios/native-handlers.json. Working-Authority Evidence for #136. The disassembly is the single last action, after the capture. The listing is untracked Restricted Material; only decoded facts enter research notes.
